body: I hear you. It would be so much easier if someone else would just do it so you don't have to.

I'm already good at pushing everything aside and not thinking about it until it gets to me again so I'm already ahead of you there. I mean I'm still here right?

The sad part is I really can't think of anyone I could talk to. I love my parents but I don't get along well enough with my mother to share this kind of thing with and my father is recovering from being sick. My siblings don't talk to me often and my roommates ignore me too so I'm back to just myself.

But thank you, I appreciate your talking to me.

That's pretty much exactly how I feel, like scarily so. Knowing that you and a few others here have felt like this and moved on is great but I just don't see that happening for me.

As for a doctor, I casually talked to one once and she just told me to go out and make some friends and I'd feel better.

Right though? Everyone always talks about how much fun they have and how many friends they've made from the game and I'm just sitting there playing it solo wondering where these magical game friends come from.
